column3: ("The gods sacrificed with sacrifice. The gods sacrificed with Agni to Agni. 'Agni was the victim; they seized him and sacrificed with him'.")
column4: ಯಜ್ಞೇನ ಯಜ್ಞಮಯಜಂತ ದೇವಾಃ । ಅಗ್ನಿನಾಗ್ನಿಮಯಜಂತ ದೇವಾಃ । ... ಇತಿ ಚ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣಂ
column5: English translation of the Nirukta quotation added; the Kannada only gives a looser paraphrase afterwards.

column3: ("They churn fire when King Soma has come. ... for Agni is the victim of the gods.")
column4: ಅಗ್ನಿಂ ಮಂಥಂತಿ ಸೋಮೇ ರಾಜನ್ಯಾಗತೇ ... ಅಗ್ನಿರ್ಹಿ ದೇವಾನಾಂ ಪಶುಃ
column5: English translation of the Aitareya Brahmana quotation added that the Kannada does not give.

column3: ("Prajāpati meditated on the forms of Agni. That boy who had entered into the forms, him he sought. Agni knew: ...")
column5: English translation of the Satapatha quotation is added and then the Kannada paraphrase is translated again, duplicating the content.
